text: Native SFIX/EFIX, SSACC/ESACC, and SBLINK/EBLINK records carry EyeLinkOnlineParser identity and remain separate from eyes4s DetectionResult. HREF summaries retain both HREF and GAZE fields; FIXUPDATE/SACUPDATE retain exact uninterpreted tails until a reference-backed semantic contract exists. MSG offset recognition requires an explicit leading sign so unsigned numeric-leading payloads remain payload; effective tracker time is logged time plus signed offset.
